POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems.
